description: This file contains linear algebra functions wrapping PyTorch's torch.linalg module, including matrix operations, decompositions, eigenvalue computations, and error handling.

classes.name: LinAlgError
classes.description: Custom exception class for linear algebra errors.

methods.name: _atleast_float_1
methods.description: Ensures the input tensor is of a floating point or complex dtype.

methods.name: _atleast_float_2
methods.description: Converts two tensors to a common floating point or complex dtype.

methods.name: linalg_errors
methods.description: Decorator to catch torch.linalg errors and raise custom LinAlgError.

methods.name: matrix_power
methods.description: Computes the matrix power of a tensor.

methods.name: multi_dot
methods.description: Performs multiple matrix multiplications efficiently.

methods.name: solve
methods.description: Solves a linear matrix equation.

methods.name: lstsq
methods.description: Computes the least squares solution to a linear matrix equation.

methods.name: inv
methods.description: Calculates the inverse of a matrix.

methods.name: pinv
methods.description: Calculates the Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse of a matrix.

methods.name: tensorsolve
methods.description: Solves tensor equations.

methods.name: tensorinv
methods.description: Computes the tensor inverse.

methods.name: det
methods.description: Calculates the determinant of a matrix.

methods.name: slogdet
methods.description: Calculates the sign and natural logarithm of the determinant.

methods.name: cond
methods.description: Computes the condition number of a matrix.

methods.name: matrix_rank
methods.description: Calculates the rank of a matrix.

methods.name: norm
methods.description: Computes matrix or vector norms.

methods.name: cholesky
methods.description: Performs Cholesky decomposition.

methods.name: qr
methods.description: Computes the QR decomposition.

methods.name: svd
methods.description: Performs singular value decomposition.

methods.name: eig
methods.description: Computes eigenvalues and eigenvectors.

methods.name: eigh
methods.description: Computes eigenvalues and eigenvectors for Hermitian matrices.

methods.name: eigvals
methods.description: Computes eigenvalues.

methods.name: eigvalsh
methods.description: Computes eigenvalues of Hermitian matrices.
